name: MultiTask Demo
description: Raspberry Pi Pico with two cyclic tasks: FastTask (10 ms) toggles LED1 on GP1 every 100 ms and SlowTask (100 ms) toggles LED2 on GP0 every 500 ms. Pins from firmware/app/boards/rpi_pico_rp2040.overlay. It has no scenario: the test engine runs one task per project, so check it on the board.
author: ZPLC Team

outputs.name: LED1
outputs.description: GP1 (led1 in the Pico overlay): fast blink, toggles every 100 ms

outputs.name: LED2
outputs.description: GP0 (led0 in the Pico overlay): slow blink, toggles every 500 ms
